body.name: Nuisance-efficient local action handle
body.construction: \(\mathsf H_{\mathrm{eff}}\): estimate \(\beta\) in the pilot by an efficient score after projection on the nuisance tangent space, map the oracle coordinate into \(G_{T_{n,m}^{\mathrm{main}}}(\beta)\), and apply the exact mixture construction on the main wave.
